query: Consider SWA's Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document state that Confidential Information shall only include technical information?
gold: 1. The term “Confidential information” for the purpose of this Agreement shall mean the said Submissions and each concept, idea, game-play mechanic, set design, business model, and/or other element contained therein and any and all other proprietary and/or any other information and/or data which is provided and/or obtained hereunder weather in relation to the submission and/or otherwise, whether in writing, pictorially, in machine readable form, orally or by observation during their interactions/discussions, in connection with the Purpose or otherwise, including but not limited to, all intangible and tangible information, documents, data, papers, statements, any business/customer information and trade secrets relating to its business practices in connection with the Purpose or otherwise, and will form a part of the proprietary and confidential information weather disclosed by the Disclosing and/or Receiving Party.
rag_answer:
No. The SWA model NDA does not state that Confidential Information shall only include technical information.

Clause 1 defines Confidential Information broadly to include the Submissions and “each concept, idea, game-play mechanic, set design, business model, and/or other element contained therein,” as well as “any and all other proprietary and/or any other information and/or data,” including “business/customer information and trade secrets.” Thus, it is not limited to technical information.

judge.gold_summary: SWA NDA 中 Confidential Information 的定义并非仅限技术信息，而是广泛涵盖 Submissions、概念、创意、玩法机制、场景设计、商业模式、其他专有信息/数据、业务/客户信息和商业秘密等。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答明确指出文档没有规定 Confidential Information 仅包括技术信息，并引用 Clause 1 说明其定义广泛，包括 Submissions、概念、创意、玩法机制、场景设计、商业模式、其他专有信息/数据、业务/客户信息和商业秘密等，因此不限于技术信息。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键结论：Confidential Information 的定义是宽泛的，不局限于技术信息；与金标一致，没有矛盾或遗漏核心要点。
